title: Moorish Sovereign Citizens
summary: ISD explainer on Moorish sovereign citizens: Moorish Science Temple roots, Washitaw and Nuwaubian groups, treaty-based immunity claims, squatting and violent incidents.

assertions.quote: Moorish sovereigns cite that treaty to claim that Moors in the US have sovereign status, meaning they would be exempt from normal laws
filing paperwork that purports to declare their “free man” status or liens and notices against government officials
engaging law enforcement in sometimes deadly confrontations
Moorish adherents have created fake deeds transferring ownership of the properties, then change the locks.
several MSTA factions have disavowed the anti-government spin Moorish sovereigns put on their beliefs.

verdicts.note: MSTA temples have publicly repudiated Moorish sovereign groups and defendants claiming affiliation.
